raw_response:
I will keep my farm centered on the wheat-maize system because that is the most reliable use of my land, my well irrigation, and my household labor. I only have 3 years of farming experience, so I do not want to gamble on a big shift. I will put most of my land into winter wheat followed by summer maize, because that fits Quzhou County conditions and gives me the steadiest production. I will keep smaller blocks in soybean and oilseed so I am not completely dependent on only two crops, and because legumes help me avoid pushing nitrogen too hard everywhere. I will use improved or hybrid seed where it matters most, keep fertilizer at a moderate but solid level, irrigate the crops that respond best, and stay on top of pests instead of waiting for problems to spread. For tillage, I will mostly use rotary tillage because it is practical for me and matches how I can manage residues and field preparation across a large area.
